description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance (compared to a 4×tokens, 4-bit baseline) when applying layer-wise quantized pruning using the SnapKV method on the Llama-3-8B-Instruct model, with different token-precision configurations. The x-axis represents model layers grouped into intervals: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, indicating that configurations are modified every 4 layers at the ends and every 8 layers in the middle. The y-axis, labeled “Relative Change,” is scaled linearly from -15% to +5%, with major gridlines and tick labels at 5% intervals. The baseline (gray dashed line) is fixed at 0%. Five configurations are plotted: LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit (orange line with circle markers) starts near 0%, dips slightly to about -1% at Layer5-12, rises to ~0% at Layer13-20, dips again to ~-1% at Layer21-28, and ends near +1% at Layer29-32. LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit (red line with square markers) begins near 0%, drops to ~-2% at Layer5-12, stabilizes near -2% through Layer21-28, and recovers to ~0% at Layer29-32. RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit (light blue line with circle markers) starts near 0%, declines to ~-3% at Layer5-12, falls further to ~-6% at Layer13-20, rises to ~-4% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit (dark blue line with square markers) begins near 0%, drops sharply to ~-6% at Layer5-12, plunges to ~-15% at Layer13-20, recovers to ~-11% at Layer21-28, and ends near -2% at Layer29-32. All lines show non-monotonic behavior across layers, with the dark blue line exhibiting the largest negative deviation in the middle layers.
